title: Settings scroll fade — how much content should disappear?

steps.path: The content disappearing under the title while you scroll
steps.hint: Scroll inside each drawer to see the fade. Scroll outside it to reach the next version. Try Meadow Mist, Halftone and a solid theme with the theme buttons.
steps.headline: Which fade hides enough content without feeling too heavy?
steps.risk: Review-only comparison. All three fade content rather than paint a coloured strip; none changes production styling. The title line's provisional 20% taper is held constant, not approved as a final endpoint. Other scrolling surfaces are not covered here.

variants.label: Earlier fade
variants.summary: The version you found too faint: content fades over 36px, with a wide taper at each side. Included as a reference.

variants.label: Stronger fade
variants.summary: Content fades over 64px, with less of the left and right edges untouched.

variants.label: Most coverage
variants.summary: Content fades over 84px, nearly across the whole width. This hides more but could feel heavy while scrolling.
